name: Clifton (United States)
description: A landscape flag: a bighorn ram in brown before orange and yellow mountains under a blue sky and above a blue river, with the town seal in the upper hoist and the motto Where the trail begins.
history: Clifton is a town in and the county seat of Greenlee County, Arizona, United States, along the San Francisco River. The flag was adopted on 14 August 2014 (approved by the town council).

features.role: landscape of mountains, river and a bighorn ram
